items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [fzf (scaryrawr) (⭐0)](https://github.com/scaryrawr/fzf.zsh) - Adds keybindings for [fzf (⭐74k)](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf) inspired by [PatrickF1/fzf.fish (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/PatrickF1/fzf.fish).
*   [fzf-nav (⭐0)](https://github.com/ivomac/zsh-fzf-nav) - Defines an interactive file/directory navigator using [fzf (⭐74k)](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf). Offers multiple navigation modes, git integration, and customizable actions.
items.content_html:
Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • fzf (scaryrawr) (⭐0) - Adds keybindings for fzf (⭐74k) inspired by PatrickF1/fzf.fish (⭐2.4k).
  • fzf-nav (⭐0) - Defines an interactive file/directory navigator using fzf (⭐74k). Offers multiple navigation modes, git integration, and customizable actions.
